root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The file the condition is about (a package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml), relative to its root; `.` for the analysis root itself

code.description: `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NO_ROWS`: a member's package.json has no rows this run, so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_EXCLUDED`: a member's package.json is routed away from the data instance (an exclude), so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN`: a dependency the manager would link by name matches no member with rows while some member's name is unknown, so it may link that member; `WORKSPACE_CATALOG_UNRESOLVED`: a `catalog:` range names no entry of the catalogs the manager in effect reads (pnpm-workspace.yaml for pnpm, the root package.json for bun; none for npm or yarn); `WORKSPACE_CATALOG_CONFLICT`: both `catalog` and `catalogs.default` are set; VAT merges them, `catalog` winning a name in both; `WORKSPACE_DUPLICATE_NAME`: two members carry one name; the first by path keeps it for linking; `WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED`: a `workspace:` range under npm or yarn 1, which fail the install; it links nothing; `WORKSPACE_PACKAGES_MALFORMED`: the member pattern list is not an array of strings, or pnpm refuses the file for a missing `packages`; VAT reads what it can and says so; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_REFUSED`: this root's workspace rows are refused (the message leads with the refusal code) while other roots answer; the root has no package or dependency rows; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_MAY_BE_ABOVE`: the analysis root declares no workspace, holds a package.json and sits below its repository's top level, so a workspace above it may hold its packages; path is `.`

seq.description: 0-based position among the path's conditions of this code

projection-workspace-conditions.description: A row of the derived `workspace_conditions` relation
